card.name: Old history prose and dates
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside older historical narrative, often in or near dates, years and dollar amounts. It fires on pieces such as a space after a month, a comma before a year, or a digit inside a number.

modes.label: Dates and numbers
modes.description: Spaces, commas or digits inside dates and sums in historical text.

modes.label: Words in 19th-century history prose
modes.description: Ordinary words or name pieces in old regional or political history writing.
